#
# baseline data and scaled
```{r}
make_df_base <- function(dat,
                         dx_col,
                         dx_keep = "EOAD",
                         amy_col,
                         ptau_col,
                         tau_col,
                         amy_date_col = NULL,
                         ptau_date_col = NULL,
                         tau_date_col = NULL) {
  dat %>%
    filter(.data[[dx_col]] == dx_keep) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[[dx_col]] == dx_keep,
      !is.na(.data[[amy_col]]),
    !is.na(.data[[ptau_col]]),
      !is.na(.data[[tau_col]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      amy_z = as.numeric(scale(.data[[amy_col]])),
      ptau  = as.numeric(.data[[ptau_col]]),
      tau_z = as.numeric(scale(.data[[tau_col]]))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      amy_z, ptau, tau_z,#tx_started,
      all_of(c(amy_col, ptau_col, tau_col)),
      any_of(c(amy_date_col, ptau_date_col, tau_date_col))
    )
}
df_base <- make_df_base(
  dat = mergedat,
  dx_col = "dx",#"diagnosis_group",#
  amy_col ="centiloid_wcbl",#"Centiloids_wcbl", #
  ptau_col = "ptau217",#"pTau217.Conc..pg.mL.",#"ptau217",
  tau_col = "desikan_suvr",#"ctx_desikan_FTP_SUVR",#
 # amy_date_col = "amy_date",
#  ptau_date_col = "ptau_date",
#  tau_date_col = "tau_date"
)# %>%filter(tx_started==0)
```

```{r}
nrow(df_base)
```

# mediate
```{r}

med_model <- lm(ptau ~ amy_z, data = df_base)
out_model <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z + ptau, data = df_base)

med <- mediate(
  med_model,
  out_model,
  treat = "amy_z",
  mediator = "ptau",
  boot = TRUE,
  sims = 1000
)

summary(med)

```

# lavaan model spec
```{R}
model <- '
  # mediator
  ptau ~ a * amy_z
  
  # outcome
  tau_z ~ b * ptau + c_prime * amy_z
  
  # indirect + total effects
  indirect := a * b
  total := c_prime + (a * b)
'

fit <- sem(model,data=df_base)
summary(fit)
standardizedsolution(fit)
```

# diagram
```{R} 

semPaths(
  fit,
  what = "std",
  layout = "tree",
  edge.label.cex = 1.2,
  sizeMan = 6
)
```



```{r}
parameterEstimates(fit)
standardizedsolution(fit)
```

```{R}
model_a <- lm(ptau_z ~ amy_z, data = df_base)
summary(model_a)
model_c <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z, data = df_base)
summary(model_c)
model_b_cprime <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z + ptau_z, data = df_base)
summary(model_b_cprime)
a <- coef(model_a)["amy_z"]
b <- coef(model_b_cprime)["ptau_z"]
c <- coef(model_c)["amy_z"]
c_prime <- coef(model_b_cprime)["amy_z"]
indirect <- a * b
total <- c
direct <- c_prime
prop_mediated <- indirect / total
cat("Path a (amyloid → ptau):", round(a, 3), "\n")
cat("Path b (ptau → tau):", round(b, 3), "\n")
cat("Path c (total effect):", round(c, 3), "\n")
cat("Path c' (direct effect):", round(c_prime, 3), "\n\n")

cat("Indirect effect (a*b):", round(indirect, 3), "\n")
cat("Proportion mediated:", round(prop_mediated, 3), "\n")
p_a <- summary(model_a)$coefficients["amy_z", "Pr(>|t|)"]
p_b <- summary(model_b_cprime)$coefficients["ptau_z", "Pr(>|t|)"]
p_c <- summary(model_c)$coefficients["amy_z", "Pr(>|t|)"]
p_cprime <- summary(model_b_cprime)$coefficients["amy_z", "Pr(>|t|)"]
```
